description: Golden vectors for the Fibre validator-endorsed TLS identity (celestia-fibre-tls-v1). Normative spec: specs/src/fibre_tls_identity.md.

cases.name: valid
cases.description: production-shaped certificate; verification succeeds

cases.name: extension_missing
cases.description: certificate carries no fibre identity extension

cases.name: extension_too_large
cases.description: identity extension exceeds MaxIdentityExtensionSize

cases.name: extension_malformed
cases.description: extension value is not a SignedIdentity DER

cases.name: extension_trailing_data
cases.description: trailing byte after the SignedIdentity DER in the extension

cases.name: payload_empty
cases.description: SignedIdentity payload is an empty OCTET STRING

cases.name: payload_too_large
cases.description: SignedIdentity payload exceeds MaxPayloadDERSize

cases.name: signature_empty
cases.description: SignedIdentity signature is an empty OCTET STRING

cases.name: payload_malformed
cases.description: SignedIdentity payload is not a BindingPayload DER

cases.name: binding_trailing_data
cases.description: trailing byte after the BindingPayload DER inside the signed payload

cases.name: unknown_version
cases.description: binding payload carries version 2 (validly signed)

cases.name: signature_tampered
cases.description: one bit flipped in the endorsement signature

cases.name: wrong_validator
cases.description: verifier expects a different validator consensus key

cases.name: wrong_chain_id
cases.description: verifier uses a different chain ID in the signing envelope

cases.name: tls_key_mismatch
cases.description: certificate presents a different TLS key than the signed tlsPubKey

cases.name: window_empty
cases.description: signed notAfter equals notBefore

cases.name: window_too_long
cases.description: signed validity window exceeds MaxCertValidity

cases.name: expired
cases.description: verification time is after notAfter plus clock skew

cases.name: not_yet_valid
cases.description: verification time is before notBefore minus clock skew

cases.name: cert_window_mismatch
cases.description: certificate NotAfter differs from the signed notAfter

cases.name: eku_missing
cases.description: certificate lacks the serverAuth extended key usage
